_note: Starter seed for the CURATED source — the candidate-supply quality lever. Raw 'trending' measures popularity, not fit (gh-trending ~7% keeper-rate in triage; broad historical/trending firehoses ~0%). A human curator filters for 'genuinely good/interesting', which is the axis trending misses. type=github-stars ingests a curator's RECENT PUBLIC stars (public data; 'what do respected engineers star' is a recognised discovery mechanism). This committed list is a small STARTER across ecosystems; the maintained curator network (newsletters, awesome-lists, more curators) is operational — extend it there. Each candidate carries source=curated:<handle> so its keeper-rate is measured and learned per curator.
